name: MEGACON Orlando
blurb: FAN EXPO HQ's Orlando show at the Orange County Convention Center, with celebrity, anime, gaming and comic-creator guests.

editions.evidence: Page JSON-LD: Event "MEGACON Orlando" 2027-05-20 -> 2027-05-23 @ Orange County Convention Center; same text on page: 'MAY 20 - 23, 2027 ORANGE COUNTY CONVENTION CENTER'.

notes: MEGACON is FAN EXPO HQ's Orlando show (same corporate network/template as the other FAN EXPO cities). Both the celebrities and comic-creators guest pages show only a 'PAST FAN FAVE GUESTS INCLUDED' section (John Cena, Diego Luna, Frank Miller, Jim Lee, etc.) with 'sign up for updates' copy, not a 2027 lineup, so guests is 'none-yet'. Cover uses the distinct red/gold 'MEGACON' wordmark logo (the only MegaCon-specific branded asset found; carousel/hero images are generic stock photos).
